_meta.fill_rank: Ordered by shortfall = freshness_target - supply_estimate, then placements. freshness_target = placement_share x 500, the SLA-134 pool size for ~2 months between repeats at ~8 GIFs/issue (min 3). cooldown_floor = max(3, 2 x weekly placements) is the bare minimum for the 7-day cooldown.
